name: Build a self-hosted multi-touch attribution engine with Supabase (first, last, linear, time-decay)

parameters.content:
## Multi-touch attribution engine - Overview


A self-hosted version of the attribution tools you would pay a SaaS for. It saves every marketing touch in Supabase, merges sessions that share an email into one person, then splits revenue across channels four ways so you can compare them.

### Why it matters
Last-touch overcredits the closer. First-touch overcredits the discovery. Seeing all four models at once tells you what your budget is actually driven by, on data you own.

### Setup
1. Create the mta_touches table (SQL below).
2. Add a Supabase credential and pick it on the three Supabase nodes.
3. Hit Run for the demo. In production, swap "Generate journeys" for a Webhook.

```sql
create table mta_touches (
  id bigint generated always as identity primary key,
  visitor_id text, email text, channel text,
  ts timestamptz, is_conversion boolean, revenue numeric
);
```

### Customize
Change HALF_LIFE_DAYS and CHANNELS in Config. Swap the Print node for a Sheet or Slack.

Built by nocode.expert. https://nocode.expert

---


## 1. Configure and ingest
Set your channels and settings, then bring in touches. The demo builds fake journeys, and some share an email on purpose so you can watch the stitching work. Swap in a Webhook for real data.

---

## 2. Store in Supabase
Clear old demo rows, break the batch into one item per touch, then insert each touch into the table as its own row.

---

## 3. Stitch and model
Load the touches back, merge visitors who share an email into one person, then work out first, last, linear and time-decay credit per channel.

---

## 4. Report
Show the four models side by side so you can compare channel credit. Swap this for a Sheet, dashboard, or Slack message.

## Configure and ingest
Load settings and receive touches (a Webhook in production; synthetic journeys in the demo).

## Store in Supabase
Write every touch to the Supabase touches table.

## Stitch and model
Merge identities by email, then compute the four attribution models.

## Report
Compare channel credit across models (swap for a dashboard).
